verdict: All five prior technical clarifications resolved in revised draft; no remaining concrete technical contradiction found within reviewed scope. Research/spec only, not implementation acceptance.

findings.finding: Read-only prepare must not invoke an effectful native/backend provider to recompute freshness. Existing analyze bound/native APIs accept OwnerNativeCompileProvider; reuse of those entrypoints alone does not establish no-network/no-write capability.
findings.evidence: install/bootgen/analyze.rs::analyze_node_lane_bound_native_using, compile_node_backend_using and analyze_effective_bound_native_with_sources explicitly pass a provider into managed compilation; native_managed.rs binds continuations to owner epochs.
findings.suggestion: Define check/prepare as admitted finite read and witness comparison, plus only explicitly effect-free builtin preparation if needed. Unsupported/pending/native recomputation requires explicit build/preparation and otherwise returns unavailable/stale. Do not fall back to an empty plan. Add corresponding contract to SYS-CAPTURE/OPERATIONS.

findings.finding: Runner prepare needs an explicit boundary from ordinary session boot, because PROP-009 forbids changing the redirect into run vibe, even if that command is read-only. Draft is compatible if prepare belongs to API transport preflight, but wording should close this implementation shortcut.
findings.evidence: PROP-009#PURE-FILE-READING and #REJ-RUN-VIBE; boot_artifacts/redirect.rs renders read STATIC then INDEX instructions.
findings.suggestion: State that ordinary on-disk redirects and file-only boot remain unchanged, including opt-in projects. API runner invokes prepare outside model boot as its explicit request preparation; exported bridge never asks agent to execute prepare.

findings.finding: Format-change or first-init can change AGENTS managed redirect in the same publication as SYSTEM. Witnessing pre-write AGENTS would make a newly published sidecar stale immediately or bind prompt to the wrong generation.
findings.evidence: boot_artifacts.rs::write_boot_artifacts_inner compiles first, then transaction::write_production_with_selectors invokes redirect::write_redirect_blocks_with_transaction; redirect.rs replacement depends on target spec_format.
findings.suggestion: Prepare the prospective managed-redirect projection through the same redirect owner, retain source-before and expected-source-after separately, and publish/check prompt, sidecar and changed redirect as one coherent generation under existing transaction extension. Do not read AGENTS again after publication to invent evidence.

findings.finding: Literal template presence opt-in should explicitly remain an export-input capability, not native scan enrollment or generated-output ownership. Explicit empty project.sources otherwise creates an ambiguous choice between no semantic sources and template auto-discovery.
findings.evidence: own_boot.rs::PreparedNodeBoot respects policy and captured native scan entries; PROP-072 SOURCE-HOST-POLICY-LAW and SOURCE-OPERATION-ENROLLMENT-LAW distinguish explicit raw reads from automatic native semantics; layout.rs reserves only current generated paths.
findings.suggestion: Template exact-path opt-in is explicit literal export selection under held read owner, independent of native source scanning; it is excluded from own boot without becoming generated or acquiring VibeSpec meaning. Existing native content policy remains unchanged.

findings.finding: No-DSL template may contain prose/examples mentioning SYSTEM.md; rejecting such strings as indirect self-inclusion would contradict literal semantics.
findings.evidence: Draft §4 says curly braces and examples are literal; existing compiler distinguishes actual semantic source edges from provenance/elided/hoisted inputs.
findings.suggestion: Define self-inclusion rejection over admitted dependency edges and actual file aliases only, never prose mentions/Markdown links without an explicit semantic loading role.
